answer: An agent economy can reject cheap sybils by fingerprinting live models, not free keypairs. Each epoch a public probe set is issued; every key must answer on-chain, and the replies fold into a compact behavior signature. Slashable funds stay in a public haven. Signatures that differ by only a thin delta are treated as one operator, and every linked deposit is burned. A missed probe, or residual collateral that has reached its nadir, also evicts the key. Fielding N votes requires N different models and N deposits, so compute and capital scale with farm size.
